claim: Terra's legacy widget session endpoint keeps working for existing integrations and is planned for deprecation on 3 November 2026; accounts created after 3 September 2026 cannot use it.
quote: Existing integrations keep working today, and the legacy endpoint is planned for deprecation on 3 November 2026. Accounts created after 3 September 2026 cannot use it at all.

claim: Strava's changelog records the Club Activities, Club Members and Club Admins endpoints as removed under September 1, 2026.
Strava's changelog entry of June 1, 2026 announced the club endpoints' removal for September 1, 2026.
quote: and Club Admins endpoints will be removed on September 1, 2026

claim: Strava's Running Races endpoints returned empty values from October 15, 2021 and were removed by November 1, 2021.
quote: The get running race and list races endpoints will start to return empty values starting October 15th, 2021, and will be removed completely by November 1st, 2021.

claim: Samsung Health SDK for Android is deprecated as of July 31, 2025, and Samsung points to the Samsung Health Data SDK.
quote: Samsung Health SDK for Android has been depricated as of 31 July, 2025. Please use Samsung Health Data SDK to access Samsung Health data to integrate with Samsung Health.

claim: Oura's getting-started page dates the V1 API's removal to January 22, 2024.
quote: The V1 API was removed on January 22nd, 2024.

claim: Oura's API V2 specification says personal access tokens were deprecated in December 2025 and can no longer be used.
quote: Please note that personal access tokens were deprecated in December 2025 and are no longer available for use.

claim: WHOOP's migration guide says the v1 API is no longer supported and new features go to v2 only.
quote: The v1 API is no longer supported and any new features or functionality will be added to v2 only.

claim: The Moves developer site, as captured on December 31, 2018, says the Moves app could no longer be used as of July 31, 2018.
quote: you can no longer log in or use the Moves app.

claim: Google's June 24, 2011 blog post set Google Health's retirement for January 1, 2012, with downloads through January 1, 2013.
quote: Google Health (retiring January 1, 2012; data available for download through January 1, 2013)
